scenarios.summary: Replay and reorder an already completed drain or close request.
steps: replay the same command and result
expectations: the same terminal response is returned

scenarios.summary: Disconnect control delivery with live state and reconnect under a new epoch.
steps: record the live generation and connection set

scenarios.summary: Reload a syntactically valid configuration containing an invalid dynamic value.
Reject a projected generation and reconnect while a newer desired generation is pending.
expectations: N+1 remains desired and applies once

scenarios.summary: Make control state unavailable while querying health, diagnostics, and metrics.
Hold an external dependency beyond its configured deadline and then cancel the caller.
Interrupt etcd connectivity without deleting durable keys, then restore it.
Expire or revoke the active election lease while the owner is running.
expectations: the old owner retires before owner-only work resumes

scenarios.summary: Deliver the same absolute metering sequence more than once.
expectations: the same durable sequence is ACKed

scenarios.summary: Deliver an unknown sequence gap or mutate a previously observed absolute sequence.
steps: skip or mutate the next sequence
expectations: durable totals and ACK do not advance

scenarios.summary: Restart either producer or durable sink with a pending absolute metering window.
Restart the metric producer and reuse series under a new control epoch.
steps: publish epoch N+1 and a stale N batch

scenarios.summary: Change namespace, listener, cluster, or keyspace mappings while sessions are active.
steps: open a session under generation N
expectations: the existing session keeps its immutable binding

scenarios.summary: Kill either legacy control owner or Rust dataplane with active sessions and pending lifecycle work.
steps: record process, owner, and connection lineage

scenarios.summary: Reject one invalid process configuration and then commit its valid immediate successor while old and new TLS users coexist.
steps: record the last-good config and TLS view
submit an invalid or skipped generation
expectations: the invalid candidate is rejected without notifying subscribers
the immediate successor commits exactly once
established TLS users retain the old immutable view while new users see the successor

scenarios.summary: Fail one managed process-local module and complete the mandatory ordered shutdown.
steps: reach ready with one exact owner
quiesce admission, drain sessions, seal final effects, stop and join modules
expectations: one bounded failure event identifies the module and public error class
the owner remains current through final sealing and joins
the owner is released only after stopped

scenarios.summary: Remove all eligible backends or make every candidate unhealthy during selection.
steps: publish an empty or ineligible topology
expectations: selection fails with the frozen bounded code

scenarios.summary: Replay, reorder, or delay a redirect command across lifecycle and generation boundaries.
steps: apply or evict its terminal result
replay N after a newer sequence

scenarios.summary: Rotate complete and partial certificate material while old and new sessions coexist.
steps: open a session on certificate generation N
publish partial then complete N+1 material

scenarios.summary: Make one backend cluster unavailable while other clusters and self-registration remain healthy.
expectations: the failed cluster keeps last-good state

scenarios.summary: Lose ownership while VIP bind or GARP refresh work is active.
expectations: the old owner removes the VIP before lease release

scenarios.summary: Compact or invalidate an external watch revision during topology refresh.
expectations: no cluster disappears because of the gap
